summary.en: Command-line cloud storage sync tool. The winget manifest lists rclone-v1.76.0-windows-arm64.zip.
summary.zh-TW: 雲端儲存同步命令列工具，winget 清單提供 windows-arm64 壓縮檔。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。
